name: ufswrbig
description: A WHOLE-BLOCK write(2) onto a UFS root -- what vi does and what a 7-byte shell redirection does not.  See src/userland/wrbig/wrbig.c for the sequence, which is elvis tmpstart()'s verbatim.  CASE G IS THE resolv.conf SHAPE: dhclient rewrote /etc/resolv.conf with 41 bytes and the last 42 bytes of the shipped 83-byte comment survived as a third line on screen.  fopen(,"w") was passing O_WRONLY|O_CREAT with NO O_TRUNC and relying on an unlink whose result it ignores -- and unlink answers EIO on a UFS root.  The assertion is the LENGTH, because the front of the file looked right in the bug report and only the tail gave it away.  Control: with the flags put back to 0x0201 it reads len=83 NOT TRUNCATED, which is the reported file exactly.
